attributes.definition: BIOMASS L2A forest height: 'forest upper canopy height (H100 Standard)' (BIOMASS Forest Height ATBD BIO-BPS-FH-ATBD-ARE-10343 v2.2.0, 2026-03-13, sec. 3.5.1); 'Top Canopy Height (TCH)' (BIOMASS Forest Height Products Format Specification BIO-BPS-FHPFD-ARE-010256 v3.4.0, sec. 4.2)
attributes.support: 200 m radar pixels (posted every ~90 m) on forest blocks (WorldCover tree cover >= 50 %), area-weighted mean over the cell
attributes.statistic: per pass: area-weighted cell mean; across passes: weighted mean, weights pixel_count/(0.01+bias)
attributes.source: ESA BIOMASS L2A FP_FH__L2A via ESA MAAP (collection BiomassLevel2a)
